title: D² audience spec
description: Schema for contracts/auth-audiences/audiences.spec.json — the source-of-truth catalog that D2.Shared.Auth.Audiences.SourceGen reads to emit the Audiences static class into D2.Shared.Auth.Abstractions. Each entry surfaces as a 'public const string {Name} = "{url}"' on the emitted Audiences class plus name→url / url→name lookup helpers.

name.description: PascalCase identifier — emitted as the const name (e.g. 'Files' → Audiences.Files). Must start with an uppercase letter and contain only letters and digits.

url.description: Absolute URI used as the JWT 'aud' claim value AND as the targetAudience argument to TokenExchangeClient.ExchangeAsync. The const's value is this URL string.

description.description: Free-form description rendered as XML doc on the emitted constant.
